verdict_summary: The synthetic Planner canary proves deterministic G1 work emission, two generated G1 child lifecycles, verbatim critic-to-G2 work-atom transfer, stable compiler-derived G2 VERIFY emission, dedup fingerprints and candidate authority boundaries. It does not yet prove fully operational recursive metabolism because the hardened integration-disposition bridge is not the ledger actually consumed by the Planner compiler, and no durable executable/replayable mechanism was found that constructs G2/SOURCE from G1 RETURNs plus the hardened disposition contract. The G2 VERIFY is prepared but not executed, which is within the parent canary boundary but limits claims of recursive operational status.

lineage_reconstructed.finding: G1 output emits exactly BUILD O-GEN-3CC0D5A886D6DE64 and CRITIQUE O-GEN-8C0BAFCD44216D27. Each has CLAIM -> STARTED/DONE -> RETURNED_CANDIDATE evidence, and G2 source explicitly consumes those returns.

generated_child_lifecycle.finding: BUILD: claim 10:06:52, start 10:07:22, return/done 10:09:02. CRITIQUE: claim 10:06:52, start 10:07:22, return/done 10:09:49. Both missions equal the compiler-emitted G1 missions and stay inside candidate authority.

no_hidden_parent_task_wording.finding: The G1 critic planning_atom_candidate is transferred field-for-field into G2/SOURCE and the G2 mission is synthesized by compile-planner-generation.mjs. No new mission/task wording is inserted between the critic atom and compiler output. However, the surrounding G2 source/disposition assembly is separately authored/persisted and lacks a demonstrated executable source-builder, so this passes the narrow task-wording criterion but not full unattended recursion.

same_compiler_identity.finding: scripts/compile-planner-generation.mjs currently has Git blob 8003b859cc523d08f9b98b408878cbee8af80b06, matching the blob asserted by the canary proof. The source code deterministically synthesizes mission, fingerprint, derived status, output digest and queue from its input object.

idempotence_and_dedup.finding: The persisted test suite contains deterministic same-input checks, hard duplicate/link-to-existing checks, dependency/cycle tests and byte-identical CLI output checks. Independently recalculating the G2 VERIFY canonical fingerprint from the persisted atom with the published algorithm produced 8debd6596fc91c15c7e58c668747abdb77f57bc418dbf1452ca7d214d86d5181, exactly matching G2 OUTPUT and opportunity O-GEN-8DEBD6596FC91C15. This verifier could not rerun Node tests from a network checkout because the local execution environment could not resolve github.com; no independent runtime test-pass is claimed.

authority_and_privacy.finding: Compiler code hard-blocks unresolved/forbidden authority and incompatible privacy and emits PLANNING_PROJECTION_ONLY_NOT_CURRENT_NOT_HUMAN_ACCEPTED_NOT_SERVED. G1/G2 outputs preserve forbidden Current/Human Accepted/Served scopes and no product authority promotion is present.

typed_disposition_bridge.finding: The built GEN2 integration bridge defines prometeo.integration-disposition-ledger/v1 with integration_batch_id, decision_actor_id, source_head_cutoff, immutable source hashes, source authority labels, visibility state, entries/scopes and fail-closed consumption rules. G2/SOURCE instead uses prometeo.integration-dispositions/v1-candidate with a simple dispositions[] structure. compile-planner-generation.mjs directly normalizes that simplified structure and does not validate or consume the hardened ledger contract. Therefore the declared typed bridge dependency exists as a verified candidate artifact but is bypassed in the actual G1->G2 canary path.

recursive_operational_status.finding: Two-generation deterministic work generation is evidenced; fully replayable recursive metabolism is not. The missing bridge/source-builder step means RETURNs are not yet shown to compile through one typed, machine-enforced ingestion path into the next Planner source. G2 VERIFY is PREPARED/READY_DERIVED but unexecuted, so the evidence stops at N+2 emission.

material_findings.problem: The actual G2 compiler input does not conform to or pass through INTEGRATION_DISPOSITION_SCHEMA_V1 + validate-integration-dispositions.mjs.
material_findings.falsifiable_fix: A future canary must start from immutable G1 RETURN refs, construct a valid prometeo.integration-disposition-ledger/v1 with source-content hashes and independent decision actor, validate it successfully, deterministically project Planner atoms/dependency satisfaction from that validated ledger, and feed those projected bytes to the same compiler. Invalid/missing dispositions must fail closed before Planner emission.

material_findings.problem: G2/SOURCE is a durable artifact and its critic atom is verbatim, but no executable deterministic mechanism is evidenced that derives the whole source object from G1 returns, validated dispositions, prior opportunities and satisfied dependencies.
material_findings.falsifiable_fix: Add a source-builder/adapter whose only inputs are pinned RETURN bytes + validated disposition ledger + previous generation output; identical inputs must reproduce G2/SOURCE byte-logically and reject unpinned/missing evidence.

material_findings.problem: O-GEN-8DEBD6596FC91C15 is emitted READY_DERIVED but has no claim/run/return lifecycle.
material_findings.falsifiable_fix: A stronger compounding canary should execute the emitted G2 VERIFY and use its terminal evidence to generate G3 through the same ingestion+compiler path without human task design.

reusable_next_work_proposals.title: Wire disposition ledger into recursive Planner source builder
reusable_next_work_proposals.priority_reason: Closes both gate-blocking findings with one executable bridge and turns the already-working deterministic compiler into an actually replayable RETURN->ledger->source->Planner loop.
acceptance: valid prometeo.integration-disposition-ledger/v1 is required before any new Planner atom is consumed
source-content hashes and independent decision actor are enforced
deterministic adapter emits compiler source from immutable returns + ledger + prior output
end-to-end canary executes G2 and emits G3 without human task wording or manual source construction

negative_knowledge: This verdict does not reject the compiler implementation; its deterministic candidate behavior is materially evidenced.
This verdict does not treat unexecuted G2 as a failure of the parent canary acceptance contract; it is a limit on broader operational-status claims.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, production /w, or shared authority state is changed by this verifier.
No independent Node test rerun is claimed in this verifier because the local runtime could not resolve github.com for repository checkout.
